m1.typescript: m1 every request carries the whole history in order

e1.typescript: e1 usage adds up over the turns

e2.typescript: e2 a failed call leaves no dangling user turn

e3.typescript: e3 stop reason is reported and max tokens marks the reply truncated

e4.typescript: e4 system is a top level field and stop sequences are passed on

e5.typescript: e5 each request is a snapshot and history is a copy

e6.typescript: e6 a blank turn is refused before anything is sent

wrong-assistant-text-only.defect: stores the assistant turn as plain text instead of the content blocks as received

wrong-usage-input-overwritten.defect: replaces the input token total with the last turn instead of adding to it

wrong-no-rollback.defect: keeps the user turn when the call fails, so the next request has two user turns in a row

wrong-truncated-on-any-stop.defect: marks every reply truncated unless it ended with end_turn

wrong-stop-sequences-dropped.defect: does not pass the stop sequences on

wrong-history-not-copied.defect: hands out its own history list instead of a copy

wrong-blank-turn-accepted.defect: sends a turn that is empty or only whitespace
